name: ai-prompt-input
title: AI Prompt Input
description: A chat prompt box that grows with the text. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and the send button turns into a stop button while the model answers.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text when you do not control it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every change with the new text.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the trimmed text on Enter or on send.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the stop button is pressed while loading.

props.name: loading
props.description: True while the model is answering. Swaps the send button for a stop button.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the text box.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Most lines the box grows to before it scrolls.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra controls on the left of the footer, such as a model picker.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the box and the buttons.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
